basis: Individually inspected original instructions in the pinned complete.asm listing, reconciled with the handwritten parser and fresh native whole-parser/control comparisons. This is semantic understanding, not full mode or alias implementation coverage. Overlapping addresses count once.

ranges.scope: Compact operator-code arithmetic maps logical/additive/multiplicative/dot operators to precedence ranks; operation47 dot receives rank6 above product rank5.

Constant token dispatch separates static constants and dynamic function-table entries, calls the selected routine with ER12 output, and propagates its status directly rather than applying arithmetic preflight error normalization.
Actual evaluator errors publish canonical F(status) to inherited ER8 while preserving return status; successful rich headers60..7F or90+ require screen1 and invoke1415A cleanup while preserving R2.
